stemMarkdown: The average of 6 numbers is 74. When one more number is included, the average becomes the sum of all 7 numbers divided by 7. If the new number added is 16, find the new average (rounded to 2 decimal places).
solutionMarkdown: Sum of original 6 numbers $= 6 \times 74 = 444$. New sum $= 444 + 16 = 460$. New average $= \dfrac{460}{7} = 65.71$.
